name: italy-supermarket-deals-scraper
title: Italian Supermarket Flyers & Deals Scraper
description: Extract current promotional products from Italian grocery flyers. Structured API-quality extraction is validated for Conad Superstore, Lidl, Eurospin, MD Discount, Aldi, Famila / Iperfamila and iN's Mercato. Esselunga fallback records are optional and excluded by default. Returns prices, numeric values, validity dates, flyer references and quality metadata.

name.title: Product name
name.description: Promotional product name as returned by the flyer source.

catena.title: Chain name
catena.description: Retail chain or banner returned by the source. The Famila source may return Famila or Iperfamila.

categoria.title: Source category
categoria.description: Category only when provided by the source; it may be empty.

priceOffer.title: Offer price text
priceOffer.description: Promotional price normalized as source-compatible decimal text.

priceOfferValue.title: Offer price
priceOfferValue.description: Numeric promotional price suitable for filtering and analytics.

priceOriginal.title: Original price text
priceOriginal.description: Original price where provided by the source; it may be empty.

priceOriginalValue.title: Original price
priceOriginalValue.description: Numeric original price where provided by the source; otherwise null.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO country code for the monitored market.

discount.title: Discount
discount.description: Discount only when supplied by the source; it may be empty.

format.title: Size or format
format.description: Packaging, weight or quantity where supplied by the source.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: Offer flyer validity start date in YYYY-MM-DD format when detectable.

validTo.title: Valid to
validTo.description: Offer flyer validity end date in YYYY-MM-DD format when detectable.

validity.title: Validity range
validity.description: Readable offer validity interval when dates are detectable.

pageNumber.title: Flyer page
pageNumber.description: Page number containing the promotional product.

offerId.title: Offer ID
offerId.description: Source offer identifier for structured records.

img.title: Flyer image URL
img.description: Flyer page or product image URL when supplied by the source.

sourcePageUrl.title: Source page URL
sourcePageUrl.description: Public flyer listing page used for this chain.

offersApiUrl.title: Offers API URL
offersApiUrl.description: Structured endpoint used to extract this record when dataQuality is structured_api.

extractionSource.title: Extraction source
extractionSource.description: Extraction method used for the record.

offerKey.title: Offer key
offerKey.description: Stable key for deduplicating the current promotional offer.

productFingerprint.title: Product fingerprint
productFingerprint.description: Matching helper for comparing similar products across runs.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
scrapedAt.description: ISO timestamp for the Actor run.

overview.title: Current Deals
overview.description: Structured promotional deals with core analytical and provenance fields.
